burstFanfare.label: Fanfare
burstFanfare.reason: Fanfare builds up as the party's HP changes, so its size depends on the team and the moment.

c2Overstack.label: Constellation 2 Fanfare over the limit
c2Overstack.reason: A Constellation 2 effect of a buildup that depends on the team.

c6.label: Constellation 6 Center of Attention
c6.reason: A Constellation 6 window for her own attacks, which are not her main damage. Its Hydro infusion and HP bonus are counted when it is switched on here.

c6Pneuma.label: Constellation 6 in Pneuma
c6Pneuma.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus to her own attacks in Pneuma, which are not her main damage, and only while Center of Attention lasts; it needs that switch as well.

skillHpConsumeStacks.label: Salon members drawing on four party members
skillHpConsumeStacks.reason: Depends on how many party members are above half HP; it scales her three Salon rows alike, so it does not change their share.
